edits.old: Then no plan consequence is returned and nothing changes
edits.new:
Then no plan consequence is returned and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC9 Each business rule BR1 to BR9 holds on every step (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-payment contract mock returns a match result for plan "T-0701"
    When TreatmentWorkflow applies the result
    Then the match consequence is read from rwb-payment and not re-computed (BR1)
    Then a matched installment advances installments_paid by one and clears its shortfall (BR2)
    Then a PARTIAL match holds the difference as installment_shortfall for the due date (BR3)
    Then a missed installment starts the cure period and a match inside it returns the plan to running (BR4)
    Then the cure period and the break limit are read from parameters at evaluation time (BR5)
    Then an unpaid cure period breaks the plan and a further restructure is barred at the limit (BR6)
    Then every step writes a decision record with the rule ID and the version in force (BR7)
    Then a step whose decision record cannot be written is not applied (BR8)
    Then no version in force is a refusal, never a default (BR9)

  Scenario: AC10 A missing credential is refused with 401 and an unknown treatment returns 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller sends no valid credential
    When the caller reads GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}
    Then the response is status 401 and no plan consequence is returned
    Given the caller holds the "Treatment and offer R" right
    When the caller reads GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} for a treatmentId that does not exist
    Then the response is status 404 and no plan consequence is returned

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given plan "T-0701" is in state PLAN_RUNNING
    When TreatmentWorkflow requests state PLAN_BROKEN without the cure period having passed
    Then the change is refused and the plan stays PLAN_RUNNING
    Then no state change is written for plan "T-0701"
